name: Primeval Cryptid
source: Pathfinder Dark Archive (Remastered), Primeval Cryptid (pg. 60), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterTemplates.aspx?ID=58
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Dark Archive (Remastered) is ORC licensed material.
rules: For a living creature. Increase its level by 1; AC, attacks, DCs, Perception, saves and skills by 1; Strike damage by 1; HP by its starting level. Rarity one step up, animal becomes beast, one size larger (reach +5 feet once Huge or Gargantuan), Intelligence at least -3; two primeval abilities.
optional: Damage: only its Strikes deal 1 more. The rules also add 1 to the damage of its other offensive abilities (2 for ones it can use only a small number of times, such as a breath weapon): change those by hand.

choices.label: Abilities
choices.note: Two of these. More make an especially tough primeval cryptid, which you might need to weaken in some other way.

abilities.name: Stench
abilities.description: 30 feet. A creature entering the aura or starting its turn in the area must succeed at a DC {dc:standard} Fortitude save or become sickened 1 (plus slowed 1 as long as it's sickened on a critical failure). A creature that succeeds at its save or recovers from being sickened is temporarily immune to all stench auras for 1 minute.

abilities.name: Broken Arsenal
abilities.description: Fragments of broken blades and spears, the remnants of countless failed attempts to fell {name}, remain lodged in its flesh. When an adjacent creature hits {name} with a melee attack or otherwise touches it, that creature takes {=max(1, level / 2)} piercing damage.

abilities.name: Grasp for Life
abilities.description: Frequency once per week; Trigger {Name} would be reduced to 0 Hit Points; Effect {Name}'s will to live is second nature, and it shrugs off death. Instead of being reduced to 0 Hit Points, its Hit Points become {=max(4, 4 * level)}.

abilities.name: Shockwave
abilities.description: {Name} creates a shock wave by stomping on the ground, beating its tail on the ground, or making another similarly violent, percussive slam. Creatures on the ground within 30 feet of {name} take {=max(2, level)}d6 bludgeoning damage (DC {abilitydc} basic Reflex save). On a critical failure, a creature is also knocked prone.
